tests.title: four seeded cases match their requests (D.W. R-0402, K.T. R-0408, T.N. R-0388, E.C. R-0384)
the queue selector: columns, filters, deadline with its source, sorted by deadline
a request that enters a decision stage opens a case by itself, once (the receive-reply simulation)
S5: D.W. partial -> peer-to-peer -> outcome 130 -> Active, 130 units to the tracker, a task for Lauris, case closed
closed cases and recorded decisions are write-once
D.W. decision document: a phone offer has none until a person records it; stored once
accept as offered / stretch / use them up reconcile through the request actions
K.T. information request: grounded draft, placeholders block review, the portal send waits for the page, then the case closes
a fax payer: the reference comes only from the send stub (simulated Sfax), never from the caller

E.C. appeal (Availity): seeded sample cannot be reviewed; the guardian signs; Mark ready for upload is not a send; the send is recorded only when the portal page confirms; the answer is recorded with its document
appeal on a FAX payer: Send records the stub reference at once (simulated Sfax); a caller-supplied reference is ignored
E.C. appeal upheld closes the request; reconsideration upheld returns to the decision with the path marked tried
T.N. peer-to-peer: held awaiting, then denied -> the case becomes a denial with the p2p path tried; then approved 150 elsewhere is overturned
T.N. p2p approved at 150 -> overturned (the 65 of 65 authorization is kept as history)
evidence is dated, sourced and gated; missing items print "Evidence missing
tests.note: verify …"; sensitive records stay out of drafts unless included

tests.title: roles: admin sees status and deadlines but no clinical text; only a clinician works the case; DS and supervisor see nothing
guardian: only the reviewed appeal letter of their own child; no dispute, evidence or other child
reconcile is idempotent and survives a day advance; no second case opens; presets both seed four cases
the status is derived from the request, never stored out of step (selector agrees with the stored status for every case)
queue: nine columns, four open cases sorted by deadline, each deadline carries a source chip, rows are links to the case
old routes keep working and hand over: Partials, InfoRequest, PeerBrief -> the case; Partials (no id) -> the queue filtered
S5 by clicking: D.W. partial -> evidence and options -> peer-to-peer -> outcome 130 -> back to the authorization with the stage Active
K.T. information reply: Evidence-missing blocks review, an edit clears it, Send opens the mock Availity page and the case closes when the page confirms
E.C. appeal on Availity: Mark ready for upload reads "Ready to upload", never "Sent"; the send appears only after the Availity page confirms (QA2 D3)
admin: the queue and the case show status and deadlines; no clinical text reaches the page
keyboard and dialogs: tabs and rows are reachable, the dialog traps focus, Escape closes it and focus returns
1024 px and 390 px: no horizontal scroll on the queue or any section
the map holds exactly the 291 ids of the inventory (191 master, 100 v3), no duplicate and none blank
every id has a status and evidence; the results file has 291 rows (PRESERVED 48, MOVED 209, REPLACED-BY 5, DROPPED-WITH-REASON 29, NOT-VERIFIED 0)
no id is NOT-VERIFIED that could have been verified: no silent removal of a kept feature, no id without a probe or a passing suite
every DROPPED id carries a reason from the review documents; drops that 00-unified-recommendations does not itemise are listed

S5[scenario] · first state: four open cases (D.W. partial 110 of 150, K.T. information request, T.N. peer-to-peer booked, E.C. denied); no Lauris task; Lauris holds D.W. and T.N. as seeded; the queue and Analytics are the baseline
S5[scenario] · first state (soft): before a decision is recorded the offered 110 units are not already in the tracker and in Lauris (an offer by phone is not an award)
S5[scenario] · 1 D.W.: the Authorizations queue row says Partial: decide and opens the case; "Open in Denial Intelligence" lands on the same case in the queue of four
S5[scenario] · 2 evidence and options: dated sourced evidence, "Evidence missing
tests.note: verify …" for what is not stored, only valid options, unverified paths labelled

tests.title: S5[scenario] · 3 choose peer-to-peer: stage peer_to_peer_requested; the page says it is NOT sent to the payer; a next task appears in My Work; owner and deadline stay visible
S5[scenario] · 4 brief and schedule: "Draft from records" prints Evidence missing items and Simulated; Mark reviewed; Set the call stores p2p_at (stage booked)

S5[scenario] · 5 log the outcome (130 units): a decision needs its document (the dialog stays open and says so); then Active, 130 awarded, dispute resolved and closed, an "Enter units in Lauris" task opens; Psyflo writes NO units into Lauris

S5[scenario] · 6 back to the authorization: R-0402 is Active with 130 units and the "Enter units in Lauris" card (with the Lauris link); the queue says Active; Denial Intelligence lists three open cases
S5[scenario] · 7 a person enters the units in Lauris (Authorization Information) and the page bridge reports it: the task closes, the mock shows 130, the two stores agree
S5[scenario] · 8 queues and Analytics (admin): unresolved requests -1 (screen = selector), units approved and offers waiting move; the admin payload and the page carry no clinical text

S5[scenario] · 9 K.T. (R-0408, Availity): "Draft from records", a placeholder blocks Mark reviewed, an edit clears it; Open Availity and send opens the mock portal; the case closes ONLY when the portal page confirms; no "faxed" wording
S5[scenario] · 10 T.N. (R-0388): the peer-to-peer call outcome "approved" at 150: overturned, Active with 150 units, the old 65 of 65 kept as history; the task asks a person for the units in Lauris

S5[scenario] · 11 E.C. (R-0384): the clinician drafts and reviews the appeal letter; the guardian signs on the phone (the signer is the guardian behind the link); staff press Send; "faxed" appears only after Send, the reference comes from the stub

S5[scenario] · 11b E.C. appeal on an Availity payer: "Mark ready for upload" is a person's note that a upload is next, NOT a send: the stage stays out of "Appeal sent" and the status out of "sent" until the portal page confirms (the way K.T. does)

S5[scenario] · 12 the leadership readout agrees with the stores: the four requests show Active, Submitted, Active and the appeal recorded state in the queue; one open Denial Intelligence case remains (the appeal waits for the payer); Analytics = selectors
S5[scenario] · no console errors on the desk, the portal, the guardian page, Lauris or Analytics
